title: Sea Spirit Deep Sea Fishing Charters
specs: Closed-toe shoes are required on all fishing trips.
Cancellation requests must be submitted in writing.
Please note no hard liquor or glass bottles are permitted onboard. 👟 Closed-toe shoes are required on all fishing trips.
Failure to comply with the required closed-toe shoe policy will not be eligible for a refund.
For Red Snapper trips - Cancelations must be made IN WRITING 72 Hours prior to departure time to be eligible for deposit refund.
Guests must be a minimum of 3 years old.
Passengers under a certain weight limit are required to wear a USCG approved lifejacket at all times while on board.
Passengers are required to provide lifejacket for children under certain weight restrictions.
